rubric: A question about the design that a reviewer should answer: discussion.

criteria.activity: An argument, a question, a disagreement or a request that a reviewer should answer

reading.why: The author asks a real question about the intent of the bound; a reviewer should answer it.

ruledOut.question: activity
ruledOut.label: code
ruledOut.why: The author asks a real question about the intent of the bound; a reviewer should answer it. It is not code: A real code change: new or rewritten logic, a fix, a new file, or a change of behaviour

ruledOut.question: activity
ruledOut.label: noise
ruledOut.why: The author asks a real question about the intent of the bound; a reviewer should answer it. It is not noise: Thanks or an acknowledgement, a bot or agent restating what was said, or a change only to CI or configuration
